kpis.label: Full-allocation coverage
kpis.definition: Resources with at least eight aggregate accepted hours divided by current capacity-ledger population.

kpis.label: Allocated utilization
kpis.definition: Current accepted allocation hours divided by standard capacity hours.

kpis.label: Controlled over-allocation
kpis.definition: Resources above eight hours with active approval evidence and at or below the twelve-hour ceiling.
